subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should the bundled github-copilot provider accept allowlisted GitHub Enterprise data-residency tenant routing with COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN/provider params and domain-scoped token caches?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and a maintainer-lane comment supports the direction, but it changes where GitHub OAuth and Copilot token traffic can be sent and adds provider setup/config/SDK surface, so owner/security intent is required before merge.

options.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
options.body: Approve the strict github.com or single-label *.ghe.com model as the supported way for the existing github-copilot provider to handle data-residency tenants.

options.title: Narrow the public surface first
options.body: Require the branch to keep tenant routing more provider-local or reduce SDK/env exposure before landing.

options.title: Reject bundled tenant routing
options.body: Close or pause the PR and route GHE Copilot behavior to a separate plugin/ClawHub path instead of core-bundled provider support.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Approve the strict github.com or single-label *.ghe.com model as the supported way for the existing github-copilot provider to handle data-residency tenants.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and left the latest item-specific maintainer-lane comment framing the remaining owner/security acceptance question.
